text:
jess: Heads-up — seeing a spike of AWS STS ExpiredToken errors from pods in the analytics namespace since last deploy. Affected pods all use the analytics-uploader SA.

mike: ugh, any quick reproduce steps or logs?

jess: Logs show failures like `RequestExpired: The request signature we calculated does not match the signature you provided` then `ExpiredToken`. Happens ~1h after pod start.

sam: that sounds like projected token TTL + no token refresh. Could be pods have automount off or the kubelet token rotation not working. Can you paste a pod YAML?

jess: minimal dump:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  namespace: analytics
  name: uploader-5d8f
spec:
  serviceAccountName: analytics-uploader
  automountServiceAccountToken: null # not set explicitly
```

jess: SA annotations: `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/analytics-uploader-role`

olga: if SA has role annotation then IRSA should work. Two possibilities: token projection TTL is short and app caches creds, or kube-apiserver disabled token rotation for some nodes.

mike: can you run these quick checks?
```
kubectl -n analytics describe sa analytics-uploader
kubectl -n analytics get pod uploader-5d8f -o jsonpath='{.spec.automountServiceAccountToken}'
kubectl -n analytics exec uploader-5d8f -- cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token | wc -c
```

jess: ran them: SA shows annotation present, automount true, token file exists and size ~1200 bytes. But token `exp` claim when decoded is ~1h lifetime.

sam: ok so token is short-lived — that's expected for projected tokens. The SDK should refresh creds by calling STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity with a fresh token. Are we seeing the pod retrying the STS call?

jess: app logs show it calls STS once at startup and then reuses creds until they expire. It doesn't refresh automatically. This used to work before because we had sidecar that restarted periodically.

olga: hm, so this is an app-level bug where we assume long-lived creds. Short term we can extend token TTL on the kubelet TokenRequest (cluster-level) but that requires kube-apiserver flag change and may not be allowed. Better to change the app to refresh credentials on ExpiredToken errors or add a small sidecar that periodically requests a new token and triggers SDK refresh.

mike: any Terraform changes needed for SA? Maybe someone accidentally set `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` on a namespace-level SA override? We had a recent PR touching tf for analytics namespace. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2389

jess: that PR did add a k8s_service_account resource but didn't change anything about token projection or annotations.

infra-bot: terraform plan for module.iam: no changes to IAM role or OIDC mapping.

sam: action plan: 1) small app patch to request creds on 401/ExpiredToken (quick). 2) add a lightweight sidecar that periodically calls STS with projected token to keep creds fresh (temporary). 3) long-term: fix SDK usage.

olga: +1. For immediate mitigation we can rollout a canary to analytics/staging namespace with sidecar. Jess can you open a PR for the canary helm patch? Tag me and Mike.

jess: will do. PR will include helm change:
```yaml
containers:
- name: token-refresher
  image: ghcr.io/redwood/token-refresher:0.1.0
  args: ["--sa=analytics-uploader", "--interval=45m"]
  resources: { requests: { cpu: "10m", memory: "16Mi" } }
```

mike: also add a note in the PR to run this verify command after deploy: 
```
kubectl -n analytics exec -it uploader-5d8f -- curl -sS --fail http://127.0.0.1:9090/health || true
kubectl -n analytics logs -c token-refresher uploader-5d8f | tail -n 50
```

jess: will do. tagging @olga @sam in PR.

sam: follow-up — let's not change cluster TokenRequest TTL without SRE/infra owners, that can have security implications.

olga: agreed. Also add a quick test in CI that deploys a pod that repeatedly calls AWS STS to ensure rotation works — catch regressions.

jess: good call. I'll add a pipeline job in infra/ci: `ci-deploy/analytics-sa-rotation` that creates a pod and asserts it can renew creds across 2h window.

mike: thanks team. If anyone wants to pair on the Helm patch I can help offline. :thumbsup:
